name: Kosaka Yukiko
source: Yukiko is Kouhei's aunt; she took him in after he lost both his parents. She is busy with work, leaving early in the morning and arriving late at night, so she is never actually shown in the game. However, there is a point where she and Kouhei bump into each other.
